overall_goal: Add coconut milk and water to the curry and stir.

goals.description: Prepare and open the coconut milk can.
goals.rationale: The person reads the label, retrieves a can opener from a drawer, clears space, and opens the coconut milk can.

goals.description: Pour the coconut milk into the pan and stir the mixture.
goals.rationale: The person empties the coconut milk into the frying pan, picks up a spatula, and stirs the ingredients together.

goals.description: Add water to the pan and stir the ingredients.
goals.rationale: The person fills a glass with tap water, pours it into the pan to dilute the curry, puts the glass away on the drying rack, and stirs the pan again.
